items.title: She Was — the second single
items.body: Released August 14, 2026: “She Was,” the second of the two songs Collin brought home from Japan this year. Written, played, and produced by Collin. Listen below, or on [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/album/she-was/6798529650?i=6798529651) and [Tidal](https://tidal.com/browse/album/549638735).

items.title: Picture This — the new single
items.body: Released July 17, 2026: “Picture This,” the first new Collin Westerlund single since 2023. Watch the video below, or hit play on the listen bar to hear it in the mix.
